contentHtml:
Dubai is a city that never fails to surprise with its amazing architecture and design. From the iconic Burj Khalifa to the Palm Jumeirah, Dubai is a showcase for innovation and creativity. But who are the people behind these amazing spaces? Who is the best young interior designers in UAE and who is shaping the future of the city? In fact, we have several names.

In this article, we will introduce you to some of the best young interior designer Dubai. Professionals who have recognition for their excellence and talent. These are the names you should know if you want to transform your space into a stunning and comfortable environment.

List of Best Interior Designers in UAE

Looking for the best interior designers in the United Arab Emirates? As the list of interior designers continues to grow, making a choice can be difficult. Finding the right interior designer to bring your vision to life is an important decision. They can work for a big interior design company or on their own as a freelance interior designer Dubai.

That is why we have a compilation list for you of the best interior designers in UAE.  Is Dubai good for interior designers? From professionals with experience to up-and-coming designers, our list features some of the interior designers with more talent in the region. Take your time looking through the list to pick the best interior designer Dubai for your project. You can be certain you will get and elegant design that will bring your space to life if you work with the right team.

Firas Alsahin, 4SPACE Design

Firas Alsahin is the managing partner and co-founder of 4SPACE Design, a multidisciplinary business specializing in hotel, commercial, and residential projects. Also, he has over 20 years of interior design and architecture experience. He has worked on projects in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. He holds an architectural degree from Damascus University and came to Dubai in 2001. There, he starts his career as a senior architect at Atkins. In 2010, he co-founded 4SPACE Design with his partner Amjad Hourieh. The aim was creating innovative and functional spaces that reflect the culture and identity of the clients.

Some of his notable works include the Yugo Sushi restaurant. Which features a futuristic and minimalist design with origami-inspired elements. The Zabeel House by Jumeirah hotel, which blends urban and industrial aesthetics with local influences. And, finally, the Dubai Frame. This is a famous structure that offers great panoramic views of the city’s history.

Furthermore, he believes that interior design is not only about the aesthetics. Is about creating an experience and a story for the clients. He draws inspiration from various sources. Such as art, nature, technology and history. He also likes working with other designers and artists and teaching. One of the most difficult issues he confronts as an interior designer is balancing the client’s vision with market trends. While being faithful to his own personal style.

Rachel Kidd, LW Design

Rachel Kidd is the founder and director of LW Design, a worldwide design firm with offices in Dubai, Hong Kong, Sao Paulo, and London. She joined the business in 2007 and has subsequently overseen many award-winning hospitality projects. She has over 15 years of industry experience and a degree in interior design from Nottingham Trent University. She began her career with GA Design International in London as a junior designer, where she worked on luxury hotels such as The Dorchester and The Savoy. She is famous for her elegant and contemporary style. As well as her attention to detail and functionality. Additionally, she says that her design approach is to create spaces that are timeless, comfortable and memorable. She also likes to incorporate local elements and materials into her designs, to give them a sense of place and authenticity.

Some of her recent works include the Mandarin Oriental Jumeira. Which is a beachfront resort that combines modern luxury with Arabian charm. The Raffles Maldives Meradhoo, which is a tropical paradise that offers a serene and sophisticated escape. And the Fairmont Fujairah, a mountain resort that showcases the region’s heritage and culture.

Her inspiration comes from travel, art, fashion and nature. She also appreciates working with people from diverse cultures and acquiring new skills and technology. Meeting the demands and deadlines of various projects is one of the obstacles she meets as an interior designer. While maintaining high standards of quality and creativity.

Vaida Buchrotaite, DLR Group Middle East

Vaida Buchrotaite is the senior interior designer Dubai at DLR Group Middle East. This is a professional design firm that offers interior architecture, engineering, planning and other interior design services. She has more than 10 years of experience in the field and has worked on different markets. Like, hospitality, education, healthcare and corporation. Coming from Vilnius Academy of Arts with a degree in interior design she moves to Dubai in 2013. There, she joins DLR Group Middle East as a junior designer. Moreover, she quickly roses through the ranks and becomes a senior designer in 2017.

She is enthusiastic about developing sustainable and human-centered designs that improve users’ well-being and productivity. Her motivation is to create environments that are useful, versatile, and adaptive to changing demands. She also enjoys using natural materials, colors, and light to create a good environment.

Some of her projects include the Hilton Garden Inn Al Jadaf. Which is a contemporary hotel that features a green wall system that purifies the air. Furthermore, the American University of Sharjah Library. Which is a modern learning center that fosters collaboration and innovation. And the Dubai Health Authority Headquarters. Which is a smart building that promotes health and wellness among its occupants.

Mohab Ayoub, Algedra Group

Mohab Ayoub is the CEO and founder of Algedra Group, one of the most famous interior design companies in the region. He began as an architect in Egypt and graduated from Cairo University. He moved to Dubai in 2008, where he established Algedra Group with his partner Eng. Tareq Skaik.

He has a vision to create places that are beautiful and that reflect the identity of his clients. Furthermore, he has a diverse portfolio of projects. Ranging from luxury villas and apartments to offices and restaurants. Combining modern and traditional elements is how he works. Using local materials, being able to create designs that feel timeless.

His inspiration comes from his travels around the world, where he observes different cultures and lifestyles. Additionally, he draws inspiration from his clients, who have different tastes and preferences. His style aims to satisfy his clients’ needs and expectations. While adding his own touch of creativity and innovation.

Working in Dubai has been a rewarding experience, as he has been able to work on some of the most prestigious projects in the city. He says that Dubai is a hub for design and creativity, where he can meet and collaborate with other professionals in the field.

Joakim de Rham, Swiss Bureau

Joakim de Rham is co-founder and CEO of Swiss Bureau, a Dubai-based interior design and architectural business. He has over 20 years of industry expertise, having worked on projects throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East. His alma mater was Switzerland’s Ecole Hôtelière de Lausanne.. His studies were hospitality management.

He began his work as a project manager for an international hotel chain, where he received excellent hospitality design knowledge. In 2003, he relocated to Dubai and became a partner with Swiss Bureau. He has now turned the company into one of the region’s most successful design firms. The firm currently employs over 100 people and has offices in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

De Rham is a famous interior designer because of his innovative sense of style. Which blends contemporary and classic influences. He has a great interior designer portfolio. For example, he has been part of the creation spaces for some of the most prestigious clients in the region. Such as, Emirates Airlines, Dubai Chamber of Commerce, Emaar Properties, Meraas Holding, Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank, and many more.

How to Elevate Modern Interior Designers in UAE

Modern interior design in the UAE has the potential to be truly stunning. To elevate modern interior design in UAE, there are several steps that can be taken.

At first pick colors that can create a modern and stylish appearance. Shades of grey, black, and white are great options. However, bolder colors, like blues, purples, and greens, can also be part to create an eye-catching, yet still modern, aesthetic.

Secondly, incorporate unique and contemporary furnishings. Select furniture that is both stylish and comfortable. Such as. chairs with plush cushions, sleek tables, and modern lighting fixtures. It is also critical to select items that are acceptable for the space and will not overrun it.

Then, pay close attention to the details. Including unique decorative details. Such as patterned carpets, artwork, or sculptures, can assist to improve the room’s environment. Consider utilizing unusual materials like metal, stone, or glass to create texture and intrigue.

Finally, do not overlook the windows. To create a unified design, windows can be covered with modern window coverings such as curtains, blinds, or shades. Mirrors may also be utilized to give the illusion of more space and light in a room.

Modern interior design in the UAE may be taken to the next level by following these ways. It is possible to create a genuinely spectacular modern interior design that is guaranteed to wow by carefully considering colors, furniture, accents, and window treatments.

How Much does Interior Designer Cost in Dubai?

How much does interior design in Dubai cost? First and foremost, interior design is a burgeoning sector in Dubai. The city’s ever-changing skyline and outstanding architecture have raised demand for high-end interior design services. As a result, the price of interior design services in Dubai is rising as well. The cost of a Dubai interior designer’s services vary according on the type of service, the size of the space, and the project’s complexity.

A comprehensive interior design job, for example, may cost around AED 20,000. A basic facelift job such as painting and furniture selection or hiring an office interior designer, on the other hand, may cost approximately $10,000. A fully personalized interior design job, on the other hand. Such as, a villa renovation design or landscaping design may cost an average of AED 50,000 and up.

There are many top interior design companies in Dubai offering their services to customers. These businesses offer a wide range of services. Such as space planning, furniture selection, styling, and 3D visualization. The cost of the services might range from AED 10,000 to AED 50,000 and higher, depending on the size and complexity of the project. However, it will also depend on the interior designer salary.

Overall, the cost of interior design services in Dubai is determined by the type of service as well as the project’s size and complexity. It is recommended to compare quotes from different interior design companies in Dubai before deciding. Additionally, customers should always ask for a portfolio of previous projects. Hence, they can ensure that the company is certified by the Dubai municipality. However, they can be a freelancer interior designer while still being a professional.

How to Hire the Best Interior Designers in Dubai

It might be difficult to find the best interior designer in Dubai. You will, however, be able to identify the appropriate designer for your project if you know what to look for and what questions to ask. Here are a few tips on how to hire the best interior designer Dubai:

  • Research the top interior design companies in Dubai. Look for reviews online from previous clients. Therefore, you will see if there are any awards or accolades for them.
  • Check out their portfolio and see if their style and design match what you envision for your project.
  • Ask about their experience with landscaping design and the different elements that go into making a beautiful interior space.
  • Ask for a breakdown of project costs and make sure you are clear on what is included and what is not.
  • Make sure the interior designer Dubai you are considering has a license, education or preparation.
  • Request a meeting with the interior designer in Dubai before signing a contract. This will give you the chance to know them better and reassure you are good working with them.
  • Do not be afraid to ask questions and get clarifications on any points that are not clear.
  • Make sure you and the designer have a clear understanding of the timeline and the project’s deliverables.

Finding the best interior designer Dubai can be time consuming, however, it is worth the effort. When you find a professional interior designer UAE, you can be sure your project will turn out beautifully. Furthermore, that it will reflect your vision. With the right artist, you will be able to create a place that is functional and elegant.

Conclusion

The city’s flourishing design business is shown by the top young interior designers in Dubai. Their unique vision, dynamic attitude, and original concepts have contributed to the transformation of the city’s interior design scene. From luxurious houses and exquisite office spaces to high-end retail stores and boutique hotels, these designers have helped shape the city’s signature style. Their originality, expertise, and devotion have enabled them to become some of the world’s most sought-after designers. These young designers are helping to define the future of interior design in Dubai and beyond with their abilities to create distinctive and gorgeous places..

However, if you need more information about the best interior designers, you can contact us anytime.

FAQs 

Q1. What makes young interior designers in Dubai stand out?

They bring fresh, bold ideas with a perfect blend of modern aesthetics and Middle Eastern elegance.

Q2. Are young designers suitable for luxury interior projects?

Absolutely! Many young designers in Dubai specialize in luxury interiors with a flair for innovation.

Q3. How can I choose the right young designer for my home?

Check their portfolio, client reviews, and see if their style aligns with your vision.

Q4. Do young interior designers charge less than established ones?

Often yes, but pricing varies by experience, project scope, and design complexity.

Q5. Can young interior designers handle commercial projects too?

Yes, many are successfully designing cafes, offices, and boutique retail spaces across Dubai.
